UI_MSF_AutoReturn: Return the unequipped light to its original container
UI_MSF_AutoReturn_tt: When enabled, a light source equipped from a carried container is put back into that container after it is turned off and unequipped. The shortcut can be changed in Options > Key Bindings under 'More Sensible Features'.
